command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('PE1','PE2','PE3'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output; Write-Output ('NODE='+`$n); foreach(`$line in (`$o -split '\r?\n')){if(`$line -match '^(interface| ip address| ip binding vpn-instance|ip vpn-instance| route-distinguisher| vpn-target|mpls| mpls|static-lsp| ip route-static|ospf| area|  network|isis| network-entity|bgp| ipv4-family|  peer|  import-route)'){Write-Output `$line}}}"
